name: Copenhagen Burnout Inventory, work-related burnout scale
citation: Borritz, M., et al. (2006). Burnout among employees in human service work: design and baseline findings of the PUMA study. Scandinavian Journal of Public Health, 34, 49-58. Kristensen, T. S., Borritz, M., Villadsen, E., & Christensen, K. B. (2005). The Copenhagen Burnout Inventory: A new tool for the assessment of burnout. Work & Stress, 19(3), 192-207.
licence: NFA (https://www.nfa.dk/vaerktoejer/spoergeskemaer/spoergeskema-til-maaling-af-udbraendthed-cbi/copenhagen-burnout-inventory-cbi): "may be used freely for non-commercial and commercial purposes, provided that the following source is clearly cited: Borritz M et al. (2006)."
attribution: Copenhagen Burnout Inventory, National Research Centre for the Working Environment (NFA), Denmark. Source: Borritz M et al., Scand J Public Health 2006; 34: 49-58.
instructions: Please answer each question about your work.
notes: Opt-in wellbeing module. Instructions are project-authored. Scoring follows the source: 100, 75, 50, 25, 0 per answer, last question reversed, scale score is the mean. Results are reflective only and never diagnostic.

items.text: Do you feel burnt out because of your work?
Do you feel worn out at the end of the working day?
Are you exhausted in the morning at the thought of another day at work?
Do you feel that every working hour is tiring for you?
Do you have enough energy for family and friends during leisure time?
